titulo: Prova da Unidade 3 (B1) — On the shop floor

leitura.texto:
JOB ADVERTISEMENT — SHIFT SUPERVISOR
Norte Embalagens is a packaging company with 350 employees. We are looking for a shift supervisor to join our team in Joinville.
The job
You will be responsible for leading a team of 25 operators on rotating shifts. Your job is to keep the lines running safely and efficiently. You will report to the production manager.
Your main tasks:
- planning the daily work and organizing the shift handover
- making sure everybody follows the safety procedures
- training new operators
- solving problems with maintenance and quality
The person
We need someone who enjoys working with people and doesn't mind working at night and on some weekends. You should be good at communicating and solving problems. Experience with lean manufacturing is a plus. We are planning to open a new line next year, so we expect you to take part in the project.
We offer
A competitive salary, health insurance, transport and a free English course.
How to apply
Send your CV by 30 November. Remember to include two references. We look forward to hearing from you!

falas.en: Ana, did you remember to clean the filling machine before the shift ended?
falas.pt: Ana, você lembrou de limpar a envasadora antes do fim do turno?

falas.en: Yes, I did. I finished cleaning it at ten. But I forgot to write it in the logbook.
falas.pt: Sim. Terminei de limpar às dez. Mas esqueci de anotar no livro de registro.

falas.en: OK, please do it now. The auditors are going to check it.
falas.pt: OK, faça agora, por favor. Os auditores vão verificar.

falas.en: Sure. By the way, the capping machine keeps stopping.
falas.pt: Claro. Aliás, a tampadora fica parando.

falas.en: Have you tried adjusting the speed?
Yes, I tried reducing it, but it didn't help. I suggest calling maintenance.
falas.pt: Sim, tentei reduzir, mas não adiantou. Sugiro chamar a manutenção.

falas.en: Good idea. I'll call them. We can't afford to stop the line today — we need to send 2,000 boxes.
falas.pt: Boa ideia. Vou chamar. Não podemos parar a linha hoje — precisamos mandar 2.000 caixas.

falas.en: OK. I'll avoid running it at full speed until they arrive.
falas.pt: OK. Vou evitar rodar em velocidade máxima até eles chegarem.

escrita.instrucao_pt: Descreva o que você gosta e não gosta no seu trabalho (ou rotina) usando enjoy, don't mind, can't stand, be good at.
Escreva instruções para um colega novo realizar uma tarefa (sequência, Remember to…, Avoid…ing, Make sure…).

fala.pergunta_en: Describe your job or your daily routine: what are you responsible for?
fala.instrucao_pt: Fale em voz alta das suas funções e responsabilidades.

fala.pergunta_en: Tell me about a decision you made and something you've stopped doing.
fala.instrucao_pt: Use decide to, stop + -ing, plan to.

foco_avaliacao: Nível B1. Verbos + -ing (enjoy, avoid, finish, don't mind, suggest, preposição + -ing, look forward to), verbos + to (decide, plan, need, manage, refuse, objetivo), remember/forget/stop/try com mudança de sentido, vocabulário de turnos e funções, explicar procedimentos.
